verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a native AI question-answering feature in Shortcut that returns answers with citations from workspace content. The only AI-related evidence is an MCP server and connections to external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI. Those are developer building blocks that let third-party tools reach Shortcut data, not Shortcut's own Q&A capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
